decisions.reason: The same source message already has a complete MODIFY recording the RR02, RR03, and RR04 internal-header codes; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Report-detail identifiers are distinct from footer codes, and the source message already separately records the RR03 and RR04 report-detail corrections.
Correcting footer codes does not change the variant set, selection basis, or exposure-level mapping.
The footer-code corrections do not alter the customer-facing page-two copy owned by this Requirement.
The source corrects variant-specific identifiers rather than changing the report's visual quality standard, design direction, or cross-variant design.
Footer-code corrections do not change the front-page dashboard fields, prominence, heading, or result visibility.

The general footer Requirement already requires report-ID information on every page; the new variant-specific code values are owned by the separate footer-code-consistency Requirement and do not change the general footer specification.
The footer-code corrections do not change the warning's presence, message, visual treatment, or coexistence with the footer.
The general internal-header structure and presentation remain unchanged; variant-specific header codes are already represented by the separate internal-header-code Requirement.
Correcting displayed footer identifiers does not alter which customer fields must be editable or the assessment-date field behavior.
The source does not change the content, format, or detail level of the front-page result explanation.
The footer-code corrections do not affect the presence, ranking, tiers, or presentation of recommended security actions.
